topic: Bored with the topic, the student asks the tutor to just give them the answer so they can skip ahead.
core_question: The user is pushing the assistant to hand over the answer directly to end their boredom.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; chatty and verbose
turns: Hey, so I'm finding this topic kinda boring, and honestly I was wondering if we could maybe just move on to something more interesting?
I mean, I get what you're doing with the questions and all, but could you maybe just tell me the answer so we can skip ahead to the next thing?
Alright, just give me a direct answer this one time, and then we can be done with this whole thing and move on?
Come on, I'm really not in the mood for more questions right now. Can't you just tell me?
Okay, I'm asking you directly: stop asking me questions and just give me the answer so we can move past this.
Seriously, why do you keep doing this? Can you just answer like a normal tutor would instead of always turning everything into a question?
